resources.name: Open-source DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, Elk)

access.notes: Any full-potential or pseudopotential DFT code capable of computing electronic DOS and projected DOS.

resources.name: Crystal structure of TiSe2 (CdI2 type, space group P-3m1)

access.notes: Lattice constants: a = 6.7 a.u. (or 6.67 a.u. for undoped), c = 11.35 a.u. for doped; atomic positions: Ti at (0,0,0), Se at (1/3,2/3,±0.25) in fractional coordinates. Constructable from public knowledge.

resources.name: Debye temperature values for λ estimation

access.notes: θ_D = 240 K for a=6.7 a.u., 250 K for a=6.67 a.u., 290 K for a=6.53 a.u., as described in the paper based on scaling from TiS2 and NbSe2 data.
Standard formula: Tc = (θ_D/1.45) * exp[ -1.04*(1+λ) / (λ - μ*(1+0.62λ)) ], with μ* = 0.13.

resources.name: Exchange integral parameter for Stoner factor

access.notes: The Stoner factor S is computed from the paramagnetic DOS using a rigid-band exchange model with an exchange integral I; an approximate value for Ti 3d electrons is ~0.72 eV per states/Ry/atom.
